criteria.note: A named human must judge whether participation, authorship, hosting, sponsorship, institutional response, feedback, and causation remain distinct.
A named human must judge whether artistic practice, embodiment, atmosphere, and voice remain legible alongside operational structure.
A named no-context reader must navigate from a project to its evidence, collaborators, methods, corrections, and open questions.
A named human must sample each knowledge class and judge whether native dispositions preserve meaning, difference, and evidentiary relationships rather than merely bytes and counts.
A named no-context reviewer must judge whether the Markdown report and repository diff make the migration understandable without treating generated JSON as a black box.
A named human must judge whether provenance, voice, authority, disagreement, negative knowledge, and social context survive across representative accession sources.
